title: ODIN pipeline web application: metadata registration and Nextflow pipeline launching for environmental pathogen surveillance
description: A browser-based application (FastAPI and Angular, deployed with Docker) for registering sequencing and qPCR metadata and launching the ODIN analysis pipelines: Kraken 2 taxonomic profiling with nf-core/taxprofiler, antimicrobial resistance detection and 16S/18S profiling with epi2me-labs/wf-metagenomics, Mpox consensus analysis with artic-mpxv-nf, and Biomeme qPCR decoding. Metadata are held in a SQLite database and results are written as Feather datasets for the Enlighten viewer.
